name: Bad Warthog 50
author: dzoshi
description: Gradient dark rounded black card that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, text color changes from #67676b05 to #928b8b, background-color changes from linear-gradient(-45deg, #111111 0%, #080808 100%) to 482fb8, box-shadow becomes 0px 10px 40px 0px #000000,
    0px 10px 20px 0px #1d098f, 0px 0px 180px 0px #2f04ca.
